messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: cross-region routing anomaly detected — elevated 5xx rate and latency for requests routed from apac regions to eu. Auto-triggered at 11:02 UTC.
jamie: I'm on it. seeing customer errors spike in apac->eu path, ~12 customers with errors.
sarah: oncall? I got the page, digging into routing logs now.
netops: quick note — recent routing-policy rollout at 10:50 UTC touched latency-based steer rules. Could be related.
michael: can you paste the query you ran so I can follow?
sarah: running: `kubectl logs routing-controller-0 -n infra | grep "apac->eu" | tail -n 200`
sarah: snippet: ```
2026-03-15T10:59:48Z WARN route-eval route_id=steer-71 priority=50 matched=eu-west2 pinned=false
2026-03-15T11:01:03Z ERROR route-eval route_id=steer-71 priority=50 applied=eu-central1 (unexpected)
2026-03-15T11:01:04Z ERROR pin-sync pin_id=pin-993 shadowed_by=policy-override
```
jamie: interesting — looks like the latency-based policy should pick eu-west2 but a policy override applied to eu-central1. That matches reports of additional latency.
netops: checking pin sync state: `redis-cli -h pins.internal get pin-993` returns stale payload with ttl 0. pin-sync service was restarted ~11:00 during the rollout.
kate: could be a race between pin-sync reconciliation and the new steer rule. If pin had ttl 0, clients might have fallen back to the policy with higher priority.
jamie: can we temporarily force a pin to the desired region for affected prefixes? I want to avoid more customer impact while we investigate root cause.
michael: +1. If we do a temporary pin, make it quick and document. Use the emergency override path: `POST /internal/pins/override` with admin key.
sarah: executing emergency pin override for prefix `customers:acme/*` -> eu-west2 (only affected customers):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/pins/override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $EMERGENCY_TOKEN" -d '{"prefix":"customers:acme/*","region":"eu-west2","ttl":600}'
```
sarah: response 200. pin-override id pin-999 created.
jamie: monitoring metrics now. latency dropping for acme traffic — their 95th p90 down from 820ms to 120ms. errors falling.
oncall-bot: Handing off to next oncall at 11:05 UTC — @kate you're now primary for this thread.
kate: thanks. I'll keep running mitigation while we debug the root cause.
netops: digging into rollout diff: the steer rule change included a new `fallthrough: allow-policy-overrides=true` flag. That wasn't intended for this traffic class.
michael: where did that flag come from? which PR?
netops: PR #4521 — authored by infra-devops — merged 10:49 UTC. It set `allow-policy-overrides: true` globally instead of being scoped.
jamie: aha. So the combination of pin TTL expiry + global allow-policy-overrides enabled caused the policy to take precedence.
kate: action: rollback the global flag, restrict to test namespaces. Can someone prepare a rollback?
sarah: staging patch prepared. I'll push a rollback to canary: `kubectl apply -f rollback-4521.yml` then promote.
netops: note — pin-sync had a bug where TTL 0 was not being auto-refreshed after an internal restart. Raising a ticket for that.
michael: customer impact summary for comms team: 12 customers affected, peak error rate +6% globally for that route, average latency increase +500ms for affected flows, window ~11:00–11:05 UTC until our override.
jamie: good summary. Kate, can you own post-incident follow-ups? Need items: patch pin-sync to refresh TTLs, scope allow-policy-overrides flag, add alert for pin-shadowing events, update rollout checklist to include pin-sync health check.
kate: acknowledged. I'll create incident board and assign owners.
oncall-bot: Next oncall rotation reminder at 11:20 UTC.
sarah: after rollback to restrict flag to canary and pin refresh fix deployed to prod, I see no further misroutes in the last 5m.
jamie: great. set severity to SEV3 -> SEV2 for tracking, then to SEV3->SEV4 once fully resolved? let's mark SEV2 now for complete mitigation but still track RCA.
michael: filing incident ticket with impact numbers and timeline. Ticket: INC-2026-03-15-0789 created.
kate: I'll draft the customer-facing note for CSMs: short explanation, timeline, and apology.
jamie: final checklist before closing: 1) permanent fix for allow-policy-overrides scoping 2) pin-sync TTL auto-refresh fix 3) add pin-shadowing alert 4) rollout checklist update 5) postmortem within 72h.
netops: logging owners on each item.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=SEV2, mitigations=[pin-override,policy-rollback], incident_ticket=INC-2026-03-15-0789
kate: thanks everyone. I'll coordinate postmortem and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
